text: 上交所数据显示，2026年7月A股新开户265.54万户，环比下降7.30%，同比2025年7月的196.36万户增长35.23%。2026年累计新开2281.68万户，同比增长56.69%。
text_en: Shanghai Stock Exchange data shows that in July 2026, new A-share accounts opened totaled 2.6554 million, down 7.30% month-on-month, but up 35.23% year-on-year from 1.9636 million in July 2025. Cumulative new accounts in 2026 reached 22.8168 million, up 56.69% year-on-year.
